title: Corpus inventory and truth protocol
risk: Unknown real-world distribution and ambiguous ground truth.
work: Create opt-in inventory scanner; define labeling guide, adjudication, privacy handling, dataset cards, slice taxonomy, and baseline corpus.
exit_gate: At least 2,000 representative images or an approved smaller pilot; double-label agreement measured; no production photos copied without explicit consent.

title: Four-rotation YuNet orientation proof
risk: Face landmarks may not reliably distinguish all rotations and poses.
work: Run official YuNet ONNX across 0/90/180/270; implement geometric features; compare dynamic versus fixed input; measure latency, precision, coverage, and failure slices.
exit_gate: A reproducible evaluation report; candidate approach can reach ≥99% precision on pilot accepted cases or documents why a secondary model is required.

title: Inference runtime and provider qualification
risk: Windows ML/ONNX Runtime packaging, provider selection, determinism, and cold-start behavior may differ by hardware.
work: Prototype `IInferenceRuntime` against Windows ML self-contained and direct ONNX Runtime CPU; benchmark CPU/DirectML/available EPs; test provider fallback and offline installation.
exit_gate: ADR update selects baseline runtime/provider policy with package-size, support, deterministic-result, and performance evidence.

title: Metadata round-trip and ExifTool integration
risk: Metadata families, maker notes, timestamps, XMP/IPTC, sidecars, and orientation writes can be damaged or reordered.
work: Exercise ExifTool `-stay_open` adapter against device/format corpus; define preservation allow/deny/verify policy; test alternate data streams and timestamp restoration.
exit_gate: Round-trip matrix and explicit guarantees/non-guarantees; no unexplained critical-field loss in baseline formats.

title: JPEG lossless rotation edge policy
risk: MCU edge dimensions produce tradeoffs among refusal, trim, partial handling, or re-encode.
work: Qualify libjpeg-turbo/jpegtran modes; build adversarial dimensions; compare pixels/coefficients, metadata markers, dimensions, and viewer compatibility.
exit_gate: Default policy and CLI options approved; no silent crop/re-encode; test vectors committed.

title: Crash-safe atomic replace on Windows
risk: Antivirus, locks, cloud placeholders, network shares, power loss, and filesystem semantics can violate assumptions.
work: Prototype same-directory staging, FlushFileBuffers, ReplaceFileW/MoveFileEx, backup semantics, handle-based identity, journal checkpoints, and fault injection.
exit_gate: Recovery state machine proven on NTFS; unsupported filesystems/conditions capability-gated; fault matrix has no source-loss case.

title: Format and codec capability matrix
risk: HEIC/AVIF support varies with Windows extensions, WIC codecs, and native package licensing/distribution.
work: Compare WIC and Magick.NET decode/encode/metadata paths; inventory licensing and redistributables; define operation-level capability reporting.
exit_gate: Baseline format matrix approved; JPEG/PNG guaranteed; optional formats explicitly gated with tested diagnostics.

title: Job-store durability and scale
risk: Long-running collections need resilient state transitions, migration, concurrency, and restart performance.
work: Prototype SQLite schema, WAL/checkpoint policy, append-only events, plan sealing, batching, migrations, and 100k/1m synthetic job tests.
exit_gate: Integrity, restart, migration, and performance targets pass with documented recovery procedure.

title: CLI contract and automation ergonomics
risk: Mixed human/machine output, cancellation, response files, and destructive confirmation can become unstable or unsafe.
work: Prototype command tree, JSON/JSONL streams, exit codes, PowerShell completion, response files, progress redirection, and golden tests.
exit_gate: CLI UX contract approved and versioned; all destructive cases require explicit flags; machine streams are parse-clean.

title: Packaging, signing, and native dependency proof
risk: Native binaries, models, code signing, installer behavior, AV reputation, and updates can derail release late.
work: Build self-contained portable package and installer candidate; inventory SBOM/licenses; sign in test pipeline; run clean-VM and offline install/uninstall tests.
exit_gate: Reproducible signed candidate installs and runs on clean supported VMs; dependency notices and update/rollback strategy approved.
